item.text:
scope schedule-analysis
  question valid-schedule
    Which complete schedule satisfies every constraint?

  observation pq-adjacency
    Q must occur immediately after P.

  observation r-before-s
    R must occur earlier than S.

  observation t-endpoint-rule
    T is neither first nor fifth.

  observation st-adjacency
    S must occur immediately before T.

  claim option-d-satisfies
    Option D is R, S, T, P, Q: S immediately precedes T, Q immediately follows P, R is earlier than S, and T is in slot 3.

  link option-d-satisfies answers valid-schedule

claim final-answer
  The answer is D.

link option-d-satisfies supports final-answer

model holds final-answer
  confidence 1
